observations: Original model Xbox One console in black.
One black Xbox One wireless controller.
The console has a front-loading disc slot and a capacitive power button with the Xbox logo.
The controller shows standard button layout (A, B, X, Y) and offset thumbsticks.
The console exterior appears clean with some minor surface scratches on the glossy section.
No cables, power brick, or game discs are visible in the photos.

claims.evidence: No games are shown in the photos.
The power supply (adaptor) is not pictured and its functionality cannot be tested remotely.
The console and controller appear to be in good cosmetic condition in photos 0 and 1.
The warranty seal on the back of the console is not shown.
Requires physical testing and a working power supply.
No receipt is shown in the photos.

risks.risk: The 'adaptor issue' may actually be a failure of the console's internal power components or motherboard.
risks.proof: A video of the console successfully booting to the home screen using a known working power supply.
risks.if_unproven: As a non-working/faulty unit for parts.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be faulty (common in this model), preventing it from reading the mentioned games.
risks.proof: A video showing a disc being inserted, recognized, and the game launching.
risks.if_unproven: As having a broken disc drive.

risks.risk: The controller may have 'stick drift' or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used in the 'Xbox Accessories' app test mode.

risks.risk: The console could be hardware-banned from Xbox Network (Live).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully signing into an Xbox profile while connected to the internet.

proof_requests: Photo of the rear of the console showing the warranty seal and ports.
Video of the console powered on and functioning (if a working adaptor can be sourced).
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as an original Xbox One. Since the seller admits to a power issue, it must be priced as a faulty unit for parts or repair until proven otherwise.
